name: You are given the following quantum programming task. Build an Ising chain of 9
task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Build an Ising chain of 9 spins with couplings J=1.16 (ferromagnetic, h=0 except h_0=-0.78) in dimod, sample with SimulatedAnnealingSampler, and verify the ground state is fully aligned against the field on spin 0. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
